description_en: Creates a custom template that includes container information, video stream settings, and audio stream settings
description_zh: 创建自定义模板，包含容器信息，视频跟音频流等设置
name: AddTemplate

parameters.help_en: The name of the template. The maximum length is 128 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 模板名称。最大长度128字节
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The container. The value is a JSON object that contains the Format parameter, which specifies the container format. If you do not configure the Container parameter, the default output format is MP4. To use other formats, you must configure this parameter. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html.

Default value: MP4.

Video transcoding supports FLV, MP4, HLS (M3U8+TS), and MPEG-DASH (MPD+fMP4).

If the container format is FLV, the video codec cannot be set to H.265.

Audio transcoding supports MP3, MP4, OGG, FLAC, and M4A.

Images support GIF and WebP.

If the container format is GIF, the video codec can only be set to GIF. If the container format is WebP, the video codec can only be set to WebP
parameters.help_zh:
容器，JSON对象，其中包含参数为Format（容器格式）。不设置Container参数则转码输出默认为mp4格式，如需其他格式则必须设置此对象。更多信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html。

默认值：mp4。

视频转码支持flv、mp4、HLS（m3u8+ts）、MPEG-DASH（MPD+fMP4）。

容器格式为flv时，Video Codec不能设置为H.265。

音频转码支持mp3、mp4、ogg、flac、m4a。

图片支持gif、WEBP。

容器格式为gif时，VideoCodec设置只能设置为GIF。容器格式为webp时，Video Codec设置只能设置为WEBP
parameters.name: container

parameters.help_en:
The video stream configurations. The value is a JSON object. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html.

If you do not configure the Video parameter, the transcoded output does not include the video stream. To retain the video stream, you must configure this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
视频流配置。JSON对象，更多信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html。

不设置Video参数则转码输出不包括视频流；如需保留视频流则必须设置此对象
parameters.name: video

parameters.help_en:
The audio stream configurations. The value is a JSON object. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html.

If you do not configure the Audio parameter, the transcoded output does not include the audio stream. To retain the audio stream, you must configure this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
音频流配置。JSON对象，详情参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html。

不设置Audio参数则转码输出不包括音频流；如需保留音频流则必须设置此对象
parameters.name: audio

parameters.help_en: The general transcoding configurations. The value is a JSON object. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html. If you do not configure the TransConfig parameter, all transcoding configurations use default values. If the default values do not meet your transcoding requirements, you must configure this parameter as needed
parameters.help_zh: 转码通用配置。JSON对象，详情参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html。不设置TransConfig参数则转码配置全部为默认值，如默认值不能满足您的转码需求则必须按需设置此对象
parameters.name: trans_config

parameters.help_en: The segment configurations. The value is a JSON object. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html. If you do not configure the MuxConfig parameter, the transcoded output is not segmented. To segment the output, you must configure this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 切片配置字段。JSON对象，详情参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html。不设置MuxConfig参数则转码输出不分片，如需分片则必须设置此对象
parameters.name: mux_config

AdjDarMethod.description_en:
The resolution adjustment method. Default value: none. Valid values:

rescale: stretches the video to fit the resolution.

crop: crops the video in batches.

none: makes no changes
AdjDarMethod.description_zh:
分辨率改写方式。默认值：none。可选范围：

rescale：范围拉伸。

crop：批量裁剪。

none：不改变

IsCheckAudioBitrate.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the audio bitrate. If the output audio bitrate is greater than the source audio bitrate, the output audio bitrate is considered equal to the source audio bitrate, and the specified audio bitrate parameter does not take effect. The priority of this parameter is lower than that of IsCheckAudioBitrateFail.
true: checks the audio bitrate.
false: does not check the audio bitrate.
Default value:
    - false if the parameter is empty and the codec is different from that of the input source.
    - true if the parameter is empty and the codec is the same as that of the input source
IsCheckAudioBitrate.description_zh:
是否检查音频码率。当输出音频码率大于媒体源音频码率时，则视为输出音频码率等于媒体源音频码率，即设置的音频码率参数不会生效。此值优先级小于IsCheckAudioBitrateFail。
true表示检查。
false表示不检查。
默认值：
    - 参数为空，并且codec和输入源不一样：false。
    - 参数为空，并且codec和输入源一样：true

IsCheckAudioBitrateFail.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the audio bitrate. If the output audio bitrate is greater than the source audio bitrate, the priority of this parameter is higher than that of IsCheckAudioBitrate.

true: skips transcoding.
false: does not check the audio bitrate.

Default value: false
IsCheckAudioBitrateFail.description_zh:
是否检查音频码率。当输出音频码率大于媒体源音频码率时，此值优先级大于IsCheckAudioBitrate。

true表示不进行转码。
false表示不检查。

默认值：false

IsCheckReso.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the resolution. If the output resolution is greater than the input resolution in width or height, the output resolution is set to the input resolution.

true: checks the resolution.
false: does not check the resolution.
Default value: false
IsCheckReso.description_zh:
是否检查分辨率。如果输出分辨率大于输入分辨率（判断条件是宽或高），则输出分辨率等于输入分辨率。

true表示检查。
false表示不检查。
默认值：false

IsCheckResoFail.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the resolution. If the output resolution is greater than the input resolution in width or height, a transcoding failure is returned.

true: checks the resolution.
false: does not check the resolution.

Default value: false
IsCheckResoFail.description_zh:
是否检查分辨率。如果输出分辨率大于输入分辨率（判断条件是宽或高），则返回转码失败。

true表示检查。
false表示不检查。

默认值：false

IsCheckVideoBitrate.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the video bitrate. If the output video bitrate is greater than the input video bitrate, the output video bitrate is set to the input video bitrate.

true: checks the video bitrate.
false: does not check the video bitrate.

Default value: false
IsCheckVideoBitrate.description_zh:
是否检查视频码率。如果视频输出码率大于视频输入码率，则视频输出码率等于视频输入码率。

true表示检查。
false表示不检查。

默认值：false

IsCheckVideoBitrateFail.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the video bitrate. If the output video bitrate is greater than the source video bitrate, the priority of this parameter is higher than that of IsCheckVideoBitrate.

true: skips transcoding.
false: does not check the video bitrate.

Default value: false
IsCheckVideoBitrateFail.description_zh:
是否检查视频码率。当输出视频码率大于媒体源视频码率时，此值优先级大于IsCheckVideoBitrate。

true表示不进行转码。
false表示不检查。

默认值：false

TransMode.description_en:
The transcoding mode. Valid values:

onepass

twopass

CBR

Default value: onepass
TransMode.description_zh:
转码模式。可选范围：

onepass

twopass

CBR

默认值：onepass

Bitrate.description_en: The bitrate of the output file. Unit: Kbps
Bitrate.description_zh: 视频输出文件的码率。单位：Kbps

Bufsize.description_en:
The buffer size.

Default value: 6000.
Unit: KB
Bufsize.description_zh:
缓冲区大小。

默认值：6000。
单位：Kb

Codec.description_en: The codec format. Valid values: H.264, H.265, GIF, and WEBP. Default value: H.264
Codec.description_zh: 编解码格式。支持H.264、H.265、GIF、WEBP。默认值：H.264

Crf.description_en:
The constant rate factor (CRF) for bitrate and quality control. Default value: When the encoding format is H.264, the default value is 23. When the encoding format is H.265, the default value is 26.

If Crf is set, the Bitrate Settings become invalid
Crf.description_zh:
码率-质量控制因子。默认值：编码格式未H264，默认值为23。编码格式为H265，默认值为26。

如果设置了Crf，则Bitrate的设置失效

Crop.description_en:
The video cropping configuration. Two methods are supported:

Automatic detection and cropping of black bars: Set the value to border.
Custom cropping: Specify custom parameters for cropping. Parameter format: width:height:left:top. Example: 1280:800:0:140
Crop.description_zh:
视频画面裁切。支持2种方式：

自动检测黑边并裁切：设置为“border”。
自定义裁切：自定义参数并裁剪。参数格式：width:height:left:top。示例：1280:800:0:140

Fps.description_en: The frame rate. Default value: the frame rate of the input file. If the frame rate of the input file exceeds 60, the value 60 is used. Unit: FPS
Fps.description_zh: 帧率。默认值：取输入文件帧率。当输入文件帧率超过60时取60。单位：fps

Gop.description_en: The maximum time interval or maximum number of frames between keyframes. When specifying the maximum time interval, the unit must be seconds. When specifying the maximum number of frames, no unit is required. Default value: 10s
Gop.description_zh: 关键帧间最大时间间隔或者最大帧数。最大时间间隔时，必传单位为秒。最大帧数时无单位。默认值：10s

Hdr2sdr.description_en: Specifies whether to enable the HDR to SDR conversion feature. When enabled, HDR videos are converted to SDR
Hdr2sdr.description_zh: 是否开启 hdr2sdr 功能。启用时会把 hdr 的视频转成 sdr

Height.description_en:
The video height.

Unit: pixels.
Default value: the original video height
Height.description_zh:
视频高度。

单位：px。
默认值：视频原始高度

LongShortMode.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable adaptive landscape and portrait mode (long and short side mode). Default value: false. Valid values:

true: enables adaptive landscape and portrait mode.
false: disables adaptive landscape and portrait mode.

The width of the transcoded output corresponds to the long side of the input video (the height for portrait videos), and the height corresponds to the short side of the input video (the width for portrait videos)
LongShortMode.description_zh:
是否开启横竖屏自适应（长短边模式）。默认值：false。取值：

true：开启横竖屏自适应。
false：关闭横竖屏自适应。

转码输出的宽对应输入片源的长边（竖屏为片源的高），高对应输入视频的短边（竖屏为片源的宽）

Maxrate.description_en: The peak video bitrate. Unit: Kbps

Abrmax.description_en: The upper limit of the dynamic bitrate. After this parameter is set, the average bitrate falls within the range of (0, 1000000]
Abrmax.description_zh: 动态码率上限，设置后平均码率范围 (0, 1000000]

MaxAbrRatio.description_en: The maximum multiplier for the upper bitrate limit. After this parameter is set, abrmax does not exceed x times the bitrate of the source video. Valid values: (0, 1.0]
MaxAbrRatio.description_zh: 码率上限最大倍率，设置后 abrmax 不会超过视频源码率的 x 倍。范围 (0, 1.0]

Version.description_en: The Narrowband HD version. Valid value: 1.0

Pad.description_en: The video padding configuration. Parameter format: width:height:left:top

PixFmt.description_en: The video pixel format. Valid values include standard pixel formats such as yuv420p and yuvj420p. Default value: yuv420p or the original pixel format
PixFmt.description_zh: 视频颜色格式。范围yuv420p、yuvj420p等标准颜色格式。默认值：yuv420p或原始颜色格式

Preset.description_en:
The video algorithm preset. Default value: medium. Valid values:

veryfast: ultra-fast

fast: fast

medium: medium

slow: slow

slower: ultra-slow

This parameter is supported only by H.264
Preset.description_zh:
视频算法器预置。默认值：medium。可取值：

veryfast：超快

fast：快

medium：中等

slow：慢

slower：超慢

目前仅H.264支持此参数

Profile.description_en:
The encoding profile.

baseline: suitable for mobile devices.
main: suitable for standard-definition devices.
high: suitable for high resolution devices.

Default value: high.

Best Practices: If you have multiple resolutions, set the lowest resolution to baseline to ensure playback on low-end devices. Set other resolutions to main or high.

This parameter is supported only by H.264
Profile.description_zh:
编码级别。

baseline：适合移动设备。
main：适合标准分辨率设备。
high：适合高分辨率设备。

默认值：high。

最佳实践：如果您有多个清晰度，建议最低清晰度配成baseline，以保证最低端设备可播放。其他清晰度配置为main或high。

目前仅H.264支持此参数

Qscale.description_en: The strength of the independent denoising algorithm

Remove.description_en:
Specifies whether to remove the video stream.

true: removes the video stream.
false: retains the video stream.

Default value: false
Remove.description_zh:
是否删除视频流。

true：删除。
false：保留。

默认值：false

ScanMode.description_en:
The scan mode. Valid values:

interlaced: interlaced scanning

progressive: progressive scanning
ScanMode.description_zh:
扫描模式。取值：

interlaced：交叉扫描。

progressive：逐行扫描

Width.description_en:
The video width.

Default value: the original video width.
Unit: pixels
Width.description_zh:
宽。

默认值：视频原始宽度。
单位：px
